correctness.rationale: The simplex-sum realization has affine total equal to the number of cycle tubes. For a k-vertex proper tube, the exact facet offset is the number of connected sub-tubes of a k-path, namely k(k+1)/2. The intrinsic projected normal has squared norm k(n-k)/n. These give the displayed distance formula. An exact factorization shows every k>1 distance exceeds the singleton distance. Summing the n singleton ball constraints gives the same radius as a universal upper bound, and equality fixes every center coordinate, proving uniqueness.

value.rationale: The cyclohedron is a classical graph associahedron singled out in the motivating literature. The theorem computes a canonical intrinsic metric invariant of its standard nestohedral realization in every dimension, identifies the unique optimal center with the vertex barycenter, and completely classifies the tangent facets. The strict singleton-contact phenomenon is not a finite table or arbitrary slice and distinguishes this metric geometry from merely knowing the normal fan or combinatorial type.
